licensingNote: Source is a real, live company (Shelf, savetoshelf.com). Generated output must never reproduce the Shelf books logo/wordmark, its favicon/app icons, or third-party brand marks (Instagram, YouTube, Figma, X, LinkedIn glyphs). The original has no raster content images, video or og:image; mockup thumbnails are CSS colour blocks, so no photo role exists. The Plausible analytics script (analytics.mammutstudios.com) is intentionally excluded from the clone and from this repo.

roles.guidance: Reference reconstruction only. Generated pages must use brand.placeholder-mark instead.
Policy-only role with no source usage: a neutral, newly drawn mark that replaces brand.logo-mark / brand.app-icons in generated output.
favicon.svg / favicon-32 / apple-touch / 192 / 512 + webmanifest. Reference reconstruction only.
Simple UI glyphs (spark, ask, inbox-tray, magnifier, plus, tick, arrow). May be redrawn; animated glyphs must keep their animated sub-path classes (.spark-big/.spark-small, .ask, .tick).
Generic source glyphs (globe, mic, document, screenshot, newsletter) used on funnel tags.
Instagram, YouTube, Figma, X brand glyphs and the LinkedIn 'in' glyph on funnel tags. Generated pages must swap them for icon.source-generic.
Every thumbnail in the app mockup and palettes is a flat CSS colour block. Never fabricate screenshots or photos; pick a colorToken from the closed thumb set.
